findings.issue: Task 6's Details section states `server/internal/handler/http_test.go` 'does not exist yet' and that this task creates it fresh. But Task 4 (wave 3, already-approved in batch 1) has a TDD Anchor test `server/internal/handler/http_test.go::TestWriteAPIDomainError_NoInternalTextInAnyBranch` targeting that exact file — Task 4 executes before Task 6 (wave 3 < wave 5), so the file will already exist with content by the time Task 6 runs. Note: Task 4's own Details/Files list also omits http_test.go, so this inconsistency actually originates in Task 4 (already approved) and surfaces here as a factual error about the codebase state that Task 6 will encounter. If the implementing agent takes 'does not exist yet / create it' literally, it risks overwriting/deleting Task 4's test instead of extending the file.
findings.fix: Reword Task 6's Details/Files entry for http_test.go to 'created by Task 4 (see its TestWriteAPIDomainError_NoInternalTextInAnyBranch) — extend it with the route-rewrite tests below, do not overwrite the existing content.' Optionally also fix Task 4's Files list to mention it creates http_test.go, so both tasks agree on the file's origin.
